item.title: GTW 2026 New Year Championship results
item.description: <p><strong>Update</strong>: This story has been updated with final results.</p> <p>GTW 2026 New Year Championship is happening this weekend in Shanghai, China.</p> <p>Notable players participating include Falcons|Xiaohai, 2G|Blaz, Reject|Tokido, Falcons|E.T., WBG|Poongko, PWS|DCQ, CR|Tachikawa, ESAHK|Micky, GG|Xian, Falcons|Xyzzy, AG|Yunwu, WBG|NaiWang, Yesports|HotDog29, Yesports|Rainpro, SOOP|Armperor, PWS|Jiewa, Lancer, Xiaozhai, Tiger, Mr. Rookie, Seal Seal Qing and more.</p>

item.title: Update: All 48 out of 48 confirmed Capcom Cup 12 qualified players
item.description: <p><strong>Update:</strong> This story has been updated with 48 of the 48 Capcom Cup qualified players.</p> <p>The third competitive season for <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is already somehow close to coming to an end already, and it's about time to start looking forward to the big finals.</p> <p>Capcom Cup 12 is coming up in a few months, and most of the 48-player pool has been filled out with only one spot remaining open.</p>

item.title: Player impressively pays homage to Queen's 'We Will Rock You' song using E. Honda in Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p>Queen released their "News of the World" album back in 1977. The song "We Will Rock You" is still popular today, nearly half a century later.</p> <p>This song is known for incorporating the sounds generated by clapping and stomping. It just so happens that E. Honda has access to clap and stomp attacks in <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/'>Street Fighter 6</a>.</p>

item.title: 60 minute State of Play to broadcast on February 12 at 2 p.m. PT and 5 p.m. ET
item.description: <p>It's been revealed that the first State of Play event of 2026 is set to stream this week. Over on the <a href='https://blog.playstation.com/2026/02/09/state-of-play-returns-this-thursday-february-12/'>PlayStation Blog</a>, it's indicated that this State of Play will broadcast live on February 12.</p> <p>The upcoming State of Play will start at 2 p.m. PT and 5 p.m. ET. We're also told that it's scheduled to run for over 60 minutes, making it a particularly long presentation.</p>

item.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' launch roster size revealed
item.description: <p>It's been more than eight months since <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/04/marvel-tokon-fighting-arcsys/">Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls was first revealed</a>, but there <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/04/240-days-marvel-tokon/">haven't been any more character reveals since then</a>.</p> <p>While we haven't gotten to see any new fighters yet, it appears we now know how many in total are going to be in Marvel Tokon at launch.</p>

item.title: Nearly half of 2XKO's developers laid off as Riot Games says momentum not enough to sustain team, FGC members impacted
item.description: <p>It hasn't even been a month <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/19/season-1-patch-notes-2xko/">since 2XKO finally launched in full</a>, but the game is apparently already facing some setbacks and restructuring.</p> <p>Riot Games made the unfortunate announcement today that they are downsizing <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/2xko/">2XKO</a>'s development team moving forward by quite a large margin.</p>
